description: This is a Java unit test class for the RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, testing various answer-building scenarios and handling of null inputs, feature responses, and error responses within the context of the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImplTest
classes.description: Unit test for RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, testing various scenarios of answer construction and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes Mockito mocks and sets up the instance under test with default mock behaviors.

methods.name: tryToGetNewInstanceWithNullCommand
methods.description: Tests that creating a new instance with null argument throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithoutResponse
methods.description: Verifies that building an answer without response results in a LiveCommandAnswer with no response and no event.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithRetrieveFeaturesResponseOnly
methods.description: Verifies constructing a response with retrieved features and checks the integrity of the generated answer.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithAttributeNotAccessibleErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Verifies constructing an error response indicating features not accessible and checks the answer's error details.
